title: This Free App Copies a Voice From a 10-Second Clip
description:
VoiceStudio is a free, open-source app that copies a voice from a short clip (3–10 seconds), designs new voices from a description and dubs videos into other languages, on your own computer. 52,915 GitHub stars, 16,775 of them this week.

The catch: the default model (OmniVoice) is non-commercial (CC BY-NC). Monetizing? Switch to an Apache-2.0 engine such as CosyVoice 3. Clone only voices you have permission to use.

Full breakdown: https://youtu.be/2CW_zb6y_ps
Source: https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio
Narrated with an AI voice (Chatterbox, MIT), made on a laptop. Animated in code.
